extra.message: Insecure Deserialization vulnerability. User-controlled data is passed to pickle.loads() which can lead to arbitrary code execution. An attacker can craft a malicious pickle payload to execute arbitrary Python code.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code

extra.message: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) vulnerability. User-controlled template fragment from request.GET.get('fragment') is rendered by Jinja2 Template.render(), allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code through template syntax.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

extra.message: Path Traversal vulnerability. User-controlled filename from request.GET.get('name') is concatenated directly into a file path without validation, allowing attackers to write files to arbitrary locations using '../' sequences.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory
